title: 第21章 我就这脾气第22章 万众瞩目人中之龙
slug: 狂仙出狱第2234章龙主燃尽
content_zh:
对于武爷的问题，陈凡肯定地点了点头。
得到确认答案的武爷，这一刻都感觉自己要起飞了。
他可是亲眼见过什么叫做‘起死人，肉白骨’！
一颗小小的培元丹，让原本不但已经断气，甚至连心跳都微不可闻的人，硬生生从鬼门关拉了回来！
武爷永远都不会忘记那个画面有多么震撼。
也是从那一刻起，陈凡在武爷心中简直堪比神明！
“那是什么丹药，有那么厉害吗？至不至于这么夸张啊。”
李昭昭看到武爷这么激动，忍不住提出质疑。
“李姑娘你是没有亲眼见过，等以后就明白了。”
武爷没再多说，主要他也不知道那种神药到底是怎么来的。
武爷只知道陈凡有着非凡的能量，他想让谁活着，谁就能活着很好。
反之，陈凡想让谁死，谁就必死无疑！
这一点在九幽监狱早已达成了共识。
少尊可掌世间生死！
“真的假的，听得这么玄乎，小姐，你信吗？”
李昭昭还是不太信，转头看向洛千凝。
“我当然信陈凡了。”
洛千凝点点头。
李昭昭暗自撇了撇嘴，有点儿无语，自家小姐什么时候这么相信一个人了。
刚才明明陈凡都已经露馅了。

若是放在从前，李昭昭刚才也一定奚落陈凡一番，只是想到之前洛千凝的警告，她才没敢吭声。
但李昭昭总觉得洛千凝像是着魔了一样，心里很是担忧，在她眼里，陈凡并没有多么优秀。
陈凡收到武爷的礼物，这才也想起来他要送给洛千凝的礼物。
“千凝，这个护身符送给你，它可以帮你抵挡三次威胁伤害，关键时刻救你一命。”
陈凡说着，从口袋里拿出来一条看似平平无奇的玉坠交到了洛千凝的手上。
“谢谢，我很喜欢。”
洛千凝接过之后，想都没想便将自己脖颈上原本价值不菲的玉佛取了下来，换成了陈凡赠送的玉坠。
“小姐这玉坠跟您的气质也太不搭了啊。”
李昭昭皱着眉头，一脸嫌弃地说道。
却怎料洛千凝无所谓地说道：“那个不重要。”
李昭昭：“……”
此刻的她真的怀疑陈凡在监狱时，是不是偷偷给洛千凝下蛊了！
“千凝，原来你在这里啊，我找你半天了。”
穿着红色唐装，拿着金丝楠拐杖的魏秋走了过来，笑容和蔼，不过面色却有些苍白。
“魏老，你怎么这么早就出来了？不在屋里多休息一会儿，魏乾坤不是还没回来吗？”
洛千凝关心地问道。
“老李打来电话，他们马上就到了。”
魏秋说道。
这时，不断有人走过来跟魏秋打招呼问好，作为这场盛会的主人，许多人都是冲着他的面子来的。
而且也有许多人希望借此机会可以和魏秋拉近关系，借此一飞冲天。

不过此刻的魏秋，注意力都在洛千凝身上，对于其他人都只是简单的点点头，随便应付一下就过去了。
“这么快就回来了吗？不是说要到中午？”
洛千凝好奇地问道。
“可能是四年未见，乾坤那孩子也急着见我这把老骨头吧，毕竟他爹妈走得早，这世上就我一个亲人。”
魏秋说到这儿，语气中不禁带着几丝悲伤。
content_en:
In response to Master Wu's question, Chen Fan nodded affirmatively.
After receiving the confirmed answer, Master Wu felt like he was about to take off at this moment.
He has seen with his own eyes what it means to 'raise the dead, flesh and bones'!
A small Pei Yuan Pill brought a person who had not only died, but even his heartbeat could not be heard, back from the gate of hell!
Mr. Wu will never forget how shocking that scene was.
From that moment on, Chen Fan was like a god in Master Wu's heart!
"What kind of elixir is that? Is it that powerful? It's not such an exaggeration."
Seeing Master Wu so excited, Li Zhaozhao couldn't help but question it.
"Miss Li, you have never seen it with your own eyes. You will understand later."
Master Wu didn't say anything more, mainly because he didn't know where the magic medicine came from.
Master Wu only knew that Chen Fan had extraordinary energy, and whoever he wanted to live would be able to live well.
On the contrary, whoever Chen Fan wants to die will definitely die!
This point has long been agreed upon in Jiuyou Prison.
Young Master can control life and death in this world!
"It's true or false. It sounds so mysterious. Miss, do you believe it?"
Li Zhaozhao still didn't believe it and turned to look at Luo Qianning.
"Of course I believe Chen Fan."
Luo Qianning nodded.
Li Zhaozhao curled his lips secretly, a little speechless. When did his young lady trust someone so much?
It was clear that Chen Fan had already exposed his secret just now.
In the past, Li Zhaozhao would have ridiculed Chen Fan just now, but thinking of Luo Qianning's warning before, she did not dare to say a word.
But Li Zhaozhao always felt that Luo Qianning was possessed, and was very worried. In her eyes, Chen Fan was not that outstanding.
Chen Fan received the gift from Master Wu and then remembered the gift he wanted to give to Luo Qianning.
"Qian Ning, I give you this amulet. It can help you withstand three threats of harm and save your life at critical moments."
As Chen Fan spoke, he took out an ordinary-looking jade pendant from his pocket and handed it to Luo Qianning's hand.
"Thank you, I like it very much."
After Luo Qianning took it, she took off the valuable jade Buddha from her neck without thinking and replaced it with the jade pendant presented by Chen Fan.
"Miss, this jade pendant doesn't match your temperament."
Li Zhaozhao frowned and said with a look of disgust.
Unexpectedly, Luo Qianning said indifferently: "That's not important."
Li Zhaozhao: "..."
At this moment, she really doubted whether Chen Fan secretly poisoned Luo Qianning while he was in prison!
"Qian Ning, it turns out you are here. I have been looking for you for a long time."
Wei Qiu, who was wearing a red Tang suit and holding a golden crutch, came over with a kind smile, but his face was a little pale.
"Mr. Wei, why did you come out so early? If you didn't rest in the room for a while, wouldn't Wei Qiankun be back yet?"
Luo Qianning asked with concern.
"Lao Li called and they will be here soon."
Wei Qiu said.
At this time, people kept coming over to say hello to Wei Qiu. As the host of this grand event, many people came here for his sake.
And there are also many people who hope to take this opportunity to get closer to Wei Qiu and soar into the sky.
But at this moment, Wei Qiu's attention was focused on Luo Qianning. He simply nodded to the others and dealt with it casually.
"Are you coming back so soon? Didn't you say it won't be until noon?"
Luo Qianning asked curiously.
"Maybe it's because we haven't seen each other for four years, and that child Qiankun is also anxious to see me, an old man. After all, his parents passed away early, and I am the only relative in this world."
When Wei Qiu said this, there was a hint of sadness in his tone.
